description: x = 0 and -0: gradient g / (2 · sqrt(x)) = ±inf; x < 0 gives NaN.
reference: torch.autograd.grad(torch.sqrt(x), (x,), grad_out) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: The gradients follow graph-ir.md §3.1.11's convention here (checked by the generator): sqrt'(x) = g / (2 · sqrt(x)): +inf at x = 0 for g > 0, and -inf at x = -0 for g > 0 (sqrt(-0) = -0, IEEE 754). Expected values are PyTorch's (autograd) in f64 on the f32 tensors, rounded once to f32; PyTorch's own f32 result meets tolerance and gradient_tolerance (checked by the generator).
